item.title: Buy a Train Ticket to Samarkand
item.prompt_text: You are at the ticket office at Tashkent railway station. Buy a ticket to Samarkand. Say when you want to travel, ask about the train times, ask the price, and ask which platform the train leaves from.
item.target_grammar: I'd like…; polite questions (What time…? How much…? Which…?)
item.fluency_objective: React to the answers with short words like 'OK', 'great' or 'perfect' and continue.
item.pronunciation_objective: Stress the important word in each question: 'What TIME…?', 'How MUCH…?', 'Which PLATform…?'
item.model_answer: Good morning. I'd like one ticket to Samarkand for tomorrow, please. What time are the trains in the morning? Is there a fast train? OK, I'll take the one at eight o'clock. How much is the ticket? Can I pay by card? Great. And which platform does the train leave from? Platform two. Perfect, thank you very much.
item.model_opening: Good morning. I'd like one ticket to Samarkand for tomorrow, please.
